The '''VX series artillery droid''' was one of the oldest but most reliable military [[Droid/Legends|droid]] models in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The earliest models dated back to the [[Jedi Civil War]] when the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] supplied the droids to both sides of the conflict. Since that [[Time/Legends|time]], the technology behind the VX series had always been upgraded to stay with the times, but the basic design of the droid remained the same. The VX series droid was in almost every major [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict, and continued to be a favorite of militaries of all kinds.<ref name="TotG" />
